name: Busa CMS
description: The editorial desk for the website content busabase-cms-sdk serves.

agentPrompts.label: Summarize what's published and what's still draft
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-cms` skill in this folder, then summarize the posts and pages by status (draft/in-review/published/archived) and flag published rows missing SEO fields, remembering that only `published` rows are ever served to the site.

agentPrompts.label: Give me the snippet to connect my site
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-cms` skill in this folder, then give me this install's Folder id and the busabase-cms-sdk env/code snippet for wiring a Next.js site to it, as shown in Help & Settings › Connect.
